title: Austere Sign
statementMd:
We are going to paint a sign but we can only afford stencils for k𝑘 letters. Update the text of the sign to use only k𝑘 unique letters without changing the lengths of any of the words, so that we can subtly fix the sign later.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/16c969845c7d5c8b3d095a6e7335c4d8dcc2c7fc.png)Illustration of Sample Input 1. You can do this!

## Input

- The first line of input contains the number of words, n𝑛 (1≤n≤10001≤𝑛≤1000), and the number of letters, k𝑘 (1≤k≤261≤𝑘≤26).
- The second line of input contains n𝑛 words. Each word consists of between 11 and 2020 lowercase latin letters.

## Output

Output a phrase using at most k𝑘 distinct letters, substituting as few from the original text as possible. If there are multiple possible answers, output any.
